chatgpt_full_context_baseline.status: input preparation measured; actual ChatGPT inference latency and correctness were not measured

engineering_guardian_python_poc.implementation: dependency-free Python prototype; not the planned Rust/Tree-sitter/SCIP engine

comparison.finding: The prototype prepares a searchable local index in seconds for this synthetic fixture, while a full-context workflow must ingest approximately the entire source payload. This does not prove the prototype is faster than ChatGPT end-to-end because actual model inference, upload and answer latency were not run here.
comparison.fair_test_required: Run identical questions against (A) ChatGPT supplied with all source and (B) UCG context-pack retrieval; score wall-clock time, time-to-first-useful-answer, answer correctness, impact recall and input tokens over at least five runs.

limitations: Non-Python extraction uses regex/brace heuristics, not Tree-sitter.
Edges are AST/name candidates, not compiler-verified call edges.
SCIP and cross-language contract resolution are not implemented.
Incremental re-indexing is not implemented; repeated cold scans were measured.
Character/4 is a rough token estimate, not an exact tokenizer count.
